12	 * logs, three egress logs, three emitted inventories — the two this round

91	 */

93		charIn('0123456789abcdef').times.between(8, 40).at.lineStart().at.lineEnd(),

132		const shortest = Math.min(left.length, right.length);
133		let offset = 0;
134		while (offset < shortest && left[offset] === right[offset]) offset += 1;
135		if (offset === shortest && left.length === right.length) return null;
